mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and can cause CNS depression; valbenazine may increase loperamide levels, elevating risk of anticholinergic effects and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor for increased loperamide side effects (drowsiness, urinary retention, QT prolongation); consider dose reduction of loperamide or use alternative antidiarrheal if CNS or cardiac symptoms emerge.
